panels.title: Log lines by level per minute
panels.description: Every JSON line the app wrote, by level. Live from boot: the server logs its configuration as it starts.

panels.title: Errors and warnings by route per minute
panels.description: Lines at error or warn, by the API route that wrote them. Empty while nothing fails; a request refused or failed adds one.

panels.title: Request p95 by route (ms)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the durationMs each completed request logs, per route. A streaming route's is its time to first byte.

query.logql: quantile_over_time(0.95, {app="app"} | json | msg="request.completed" | unwrap durationMs [5m]) by (route)

panels.title: Guard refusals by reason, last hour
panels.description: Queries the SQL, PromQL and LogQL guards refused in the last hour, by language and the class of rule. A refused model draft counts as well as a refused panel.

panels.title: Request log
panels.description: One line per API request: method, route, status and duration, newest first. Expand a line for its request id and the rest of its fields.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: The app's error lines, newest first.
